name: M00 binomP coefficient corrupted
find: for (let i = 0; i < k; i++) c = (c * (rows - i)) / (i + 1);
replace: for (let i = 0; i < k; i++) c = (c * rows) / (i + 1);
guard: Step 13 rejects incorrect binomial coefficients using an independent Pascal recurrence. RTP enumeration and pinned-RTP unit tests also check this calculation.

name: M01 RNG chunk endianness flipped (BE -> LE)
guard: The independent HMAC validation vectors and captured-bet unit fixture reject little-endian interpretation of the digest words.

name: M02 payout table cell corrupted (config edited, pin left alone)
guard: The multiplier-table SHA-256 guard rejects changed table bytes before unit tests use them.

name: M03 duplicate nonce inside an epoch
replace:
const cfg = loadPlinkoConfig();
ds.bets[1].nonce = ds.bets[0].nonce; // MUTATION: duplicate nonce
guard: Step 4 rejects duplicate nonces and requires each epoch to contain the declared consecutive nonce population.

name: M04 non-numeric winningAmount
replace:
const cfg = loadPlinkoConfig();
ds.bets[0].winningAmount = 'not-a-number'; // MUTATION: NaN amount
guard: Step 8 rejects non-finite payout operands before comparing winningAmount with betAmount multiplied by the recorded multiplier.

name: M05 bet relabelled to an undeclared phase
replace:
const cfg = loadPlinkoConfig();
ds.bets[0].phase = 'Z'; // MUTATION: undeclared phase label
guard: Step 11 compares phase labels and counts with the declared capture population and rejects undeclared phases.

name: M06 meta.preCapture removed
replace:
const cfg = loadPlinkoConfig();
delete ds.meta.preCapture; // MUTATION: drop the pre-capture anchor
guard: Step 2 requires the pre-capture commitment link and rejects its absence.

name: M07 Pass 1 statistics blanked on one config
guard: Step 16 requires finite statistics for every Pass 1 row and rejects a blanked slot p-value instead of counting the row as a statistical pass.

name: M08 Pass 1 simulated RTP drifted off theory
guard: Step 16 requires each simulated RTP to fall within six standard errors of the theoretical RTP derived from the pinned table.

name: M09 Pass 2 population shrunk (one epoch's row relabelled away)
guard: Step 17 derives its epoch population from the dataset. Relabelling a saved result away from a revealed epoch leaves that epoch without a result and must fail.

name: M10 Pass 2 payout-weighted summary fabricated
guard: Step 17 rejects a Pass 2 payout-weighted summary that disagrees with recomputation.

name: M11 calibrated expectation inflated in the calibration artifact
guard: Step 17 re-derives the calibrated expectation from the dataset and payout tables instead of trusting the stored summary.

name: M12 calibrated per-config left tail replaced by the naive 0.05
guard: Step 17 re-derives each configuration’s exact left-tail probability and rejects replacement by a generic 5% assumption.

name: M13 calibration paired with a different simulation artifact
guard: Step 17 requires the calibration artifact to identify the SHA-256 of the simulation artifact being assessed.

name: M14 published dataset hash drifted in a chapter
guard: Step 20 scans the published Markdown documents and rejects a dataset hash that differs from the pinned dataset.

name: M15 Pass 1 declares a population the pinned config does not have
guard: Step 16 requires the saved Pass 1 configuration population to match the configurations declared by the pinned tables.

name: M16 Pass 1 result set emptied while the header keeps the round counts
replace:
const sim = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(simPath, 'utf-8'));
  sim.pass1_fresh_seeds.configs = 28; sim.pass1_fresh_seeds.results = []; // MUTATION: the 28,000,000-round simulation is absent
guard: Step 16 rejects an empty Pass 1 result set even when the header still declares the expected population.

name: M17 Pass 1 rows replaced by 28 identical copies of one board
replace:
const pass1 = sim.pass1_fresh_seeds ?? {};
  pass1.results = Array.from({ length: 28 }, () => JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(pass1.results[0]))); // MUTATION: 28 copies of one config
guard: Step 16 requires each expected board exactly once and rejects a result set made of repeated copies of one board.

name: M18 one Pass 1 board relabelled onto another (artifact edit)
guard: Step 16 rejects duplicate or missing configuration identities caused by relabelling a board.

name: M19 calibration per-epoch population relabelled onto another board
guard: Step 17 derives each epoch’s board from the captured bets and rejects a different assignment in the calibration artifact.

name: M20 calibration cross-check anchor fabricated
guard: Step 17 re-derives the closed-form calibration cross-check and rejects fabricated anchor values.

name: M21 calibration per-config payout SD doctored
guard: Step 17 re-derives each configuration’s payout moments and threshold values, including its standard deviation.

name: M22 calibration method string replaced
replace: "method": "I made this up. exact lattice convolution
guard: Step 17 checks the calibration method identifier against the method implemented in src/calibration.ts.

name: M23 Step 6 local re-drop forced to coincide on 5% of samples (injected coincidence rate)
find: const wrong = revealPlinko(ss, WRONG_CLIENT, b.nonce, b.numberOfRows);
replace: const wrong = tested % 20 === 0 ? correct : revealPlinko(ss, WRONG_CLIENT, b.nonce, b.numberOfRows); // MUTATION: 5% of drops ignore the client seed
guard: Step 6 checks local client-seed sensitivity using a Poisson-binomial coincidence model. Injecting a 5% same-path rate must fail. This is a local recomputation test; Step 5 compares against recorded server results.

name: M24 audited population pin moved off the delivered capture
guard: Step 11 requires the capture to match the population declared in source and rejects a population pin that disagrees with the delivered dataset.

name: M25 EXPECTED_EPOCH_SIZE moved off 50
guard: Step 12 requires the declared epoch size and mutually consistent population constants. Moving the epoch-size constant away from the captured 50 bets must fail.

name: M26 Pass 1 row's simRTP AND theoreticalRTP moved together to a fabricated 200%
guard: Step 16 derives theoretical RTP from the pinned tables and compares simulated RTP with that reference. Moving both stored RTP fields to 200% cannot make them agree with the independent reference.

name: M27 recorded drop paths regenerated from a different client seed
guard: Step 5 rejects recorded paths generated with a different client seed. The edit is injected after loading so it exercises outcome recomputation rather than the dataset hash guard.

name: M28 negative count of configurations in the coverage artifact
guard: Step 20 rejects a negative configuration count using the coverage artifact’s declared value domain.

name: M29 probability above 1 in the calibration artifact
guard: Step 17 rejects a probability above one through both value-domain validation and calibration recomputation.

name: M30 simulated RTP outside the attainable paytable range
guard: Step 16 rejects simulated RTP outside the minimum and maximum multipliers attainable from the pinned payout table.

name: M31 Pass 2 edge-hit count inflated past the drops the experiment contains
guard: Step 17 re-counts edge hits and bounds them by the number of simulated drops. A larger count must fail.

name: M32 Pass 2 window RTP set to a value its own board cannot pay
guard: Step 17 re-derives each window RTP and checks its board-specific payout range. A zero RTP is impossible on the sampled board whose minimum multiplier is 0.5.

name: M33 Pass 2 early-late two-sided p-value replaced by zero
guard: Step 17 re-derives the early-minus-late two-sided p-value from the per-epoch statistics. A legal probability value still fails if it is numerically wrong.
